records.title: Expansion of PM Mitra Scheme.
details: अब मैं इतना ही कहूंगा कि राज्य सरकार के साथ मिल कर हम लोग वहां काम करेंगे और वहां की बेहतरी के लिए राज्य सरकार से बात करेंगे।

records.title: Non-Fossil Energy
details: Sir, as I have already explained, we have sanctioned about 1,60,000 pumps under Component C for feeder level solarisation. The Renewable Purchase Obligation is also 66%. Regarding the PM-KUSUM scheme in relation to a particular area, I will examine it and inform the Hon'ble member. We allocated it to the states as per their demand. PM-KUSUM is a demand driven scheme. We allocate as per the demand received from respective States. The State Government decides where to install it. If there is any such issue, then we will see about it.
